title: National Security Act passed weeks after Roswell

tellings.quote: believe the National Security Act was September 1947 and Roswell was July of 1947.

plain: The National Security Act of 1947, the law that reorganised America's military and intelligence agencies, came in September 1947, just weeks after the reported crash of something near Roswell, New Mexico, that July. Michels points out the timing himself, giving the dates from memory, as a hint that the crash may have shaped how the government set up its secret agencies.
